title: SanDisk 256GB Fortnite USB Flash Drive (Peely Edition, SDCZIF-256G-G46)

comparisons.notes: SanDisk 256GB Fortnite USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive (Peely Edition), MFR SDCZIF-256G-G46, 256GB selected, shown In Stock.

writeup: SanDisk's 256GB Fortnite USB flash drive in the Peely edition (model SDCZIF-256G-G46) is a USB 3.2 Gen 1 stick with up to 130MB/s reads, and it comes with a redeemable in-game Fortnite wrap. Woot has it new for $22.99, while B&H Photo charges $39.99 for the same drive, so you save about $17. Woot showed only 1 left, limit 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN B0DY8JVNC8 matches SanDisk SDCZIF-256G-G46 (UPC 619659217525) per verified exact-match check.
